title: URM architecture recipe
description: A versioned, declarative description of a complete model graph: layer order, parameters, and cache/state contracts. Unlike a kernel fragment, a complete architecture recipe must state its full layer graph and explicitly list model-specific components that live outside URM core under architectures/<name>/. An unrepresentable component makes the full-model row unsupported rather than silently degrading to a generic mixer.

kind.description: Declares that this document describes a complete model graph, not a fragment.

source.description: Provenance for the source architecture this graph reproduces.

comparator.description: The pinned comparator module under benchmarks/comparators/ that establishes parity.

layers.description: Ordered layer graph. Each layer references a registered typed operation or kernel-fragment recipe by name, plus any external (architecture-specific) component.

operation.description: Name of a registered typed operation or kernel-fragment recipe.

external_component.description: Path under architectures/<name>/ supplying a model-specific component when a typed reusable operation is insufficient.

coverage.description: Honest evidence scope for this architecture row.

level.description: source_architecture requires full source-model validation; generic_model_integration is only a generic decoder swap.
